items.caption:
Do scary movies give you nightmares? One survey found a link.
Of 1,287 people, those who reported violent media within 90 minutes of bed were about 13 times more likely to report a violent dream that night. A link, not proof.

Frankenstein began as a waking dream.
In 1816, aged 18, Mary Shelley lay in bed, eyes closed but not asleep, and saw a student kneeling by the creature he had made. She wrote it down the next day. Happy Halloween.
